data.content:
Background Management User
A user role capable of performing background operations like product management, order management, and user management (not included in the current version).

User Information Modification
A function allowing users to modify basic information such as nickname, password, avatar, and gender.

User Module
A module providing basic account management functions such as registration, login, profile maintenance, and shipping address management.

User Login
A function enabling users to log in using their username/email and password.

B2C Mall Platform
A business-to-consumer mall platform featuring core modules like product display, shopping process, order management, and user information management.

Phone/Email Binding
A function for users to bind or change their phone number or email for security and notification purposes.

Ordinary User
A user role with permissions for browsing products, placing orders, payments, checking orders, and leaving reviews.

Verification Code
A method for sending SMS verification codes for validation during phone/email binding or other processes.<SEP>Verification code is a 6-digit numeric code used for authentication, valid for 5 minutes.

Login Business Rules
Rules supporting both email and username login with fuzzy matching for account existence.

User Registration
A function allowing new users to create accounts using email or username and password.

Online Shopping System
An online shopping platform supporting user registration, login, product browsing, shopping cart management, order creation, payment, and reviews.

User Registration Business Rules
Business rules for username uniqueness (4-20 alphanumeric characters), minimum password length (6+ characters), and email format requirements.

Verification Code Rules
Rules about verification code validity (5 minutes), sending limits (5/hour), and unique account binding constraints.

User Registration Status Rules
Rules defining new user status as "normal" and recording registration time with a default avatar.

Login Status Rules
Rules about updating user active time and logging device/time/IP upon successful login.

User Information Business Rules
Rules for nickname length (≤20 chars), gender values (male/female/secret), and avatar specifications (2MB max, PNG/JPG/JPEG formats).

Shipping Address Management
A function allowing users to add, edit, delete, and set default shipping addresses for orders.

客服人员
Customer service personnel.<SEP>客服人员负责处理用户申诉和查找订单用户。

系统管理员
System administrator with high-level permissions.<SEP>系统管理员拥有封禁、删除用户等权限。<SEP>A role with permissions to perform operations and export data.

运营人员
运营人员或管理员具有商品管理权限，可新增、编辑、上下架、删除商品。<SEP>Operational staff.<SEP>运营人员负责进行用户标签运营。

封禁/解封用户
管理员可封禁或解封用户，控制登录权限。

用户列表查询
管理员可通过多条件筛选快速定位用户账户。<SEP>Function for filtering and searching user account information.

查看用户详情
管理员可查看用户完整信息与行为记录。

重置用户密码
仅限超级管理员操作的敏感功能，可重置用户密码。<SEP>A sensitive operation allowing administrators to reset user passwords under specific conditions.

封禁状态
用户状态分为正常(可登录、可操作)和封禁(不可登录，接口拒绝访问)。

封禁理由
封禁操作需记录封禁理由，且不能为空。

超级管理员
超级管理员拥有重置用户密码等敏感操作权限。<SEP>A role with the highest level of permissions, including resetting user passwords.

Backend Category Tree
A hierarchical structure used to organize categories, supports up to three levels with parent_id and tree_path.

用户标签管理
用于用户分群和精细化运营，可批量赋值/移除标签。

Category Hierarchy
Supports up to three levels of classification, stored using parent_id and tree_path.

Is_Deleted Flag
A boolean flag indicating whether a category is deleted, setting it to true hides the category from the backend tree.

Historical Order Data
Retained data for purposes such as historical order tracking and statistical analysis.

Category Image
Used for displaying icons on the homepage or banners on category pages, as per frontend design.

Product Dependency
Products must be bound to the most granular level of classification to enhance filtering precision.

Order Management Module
Provides functionalities for order data querying, shipping, cancellation, and ensures transaction flow integrity.

Order List Pagination Query
Allows viewing all order lists with support for conditional search and pagination.

Order Detail View
Displays comprehensive order information for confirming shipments and handling after-sales processes.

Order Status
Tracks the lifecycle of an order from creation to finalization or cancellation.<SEP>The current state of an order, such as '待支付' (awaiting payment), '已发货' (shipped), or '已完成' (completed).<SEP>Represents the state of an order, such as pending payment, paid, shipped, etc.

Order Number
A unique identifier for an order, generated in a specific format (e.g., '年月日+用户ID+随机码').<SEP>A unique identifier for each order, used for search and reference.

Creation Time Range
A time period used to filter orders based on their creation dates.

Shipping Status
Indicates whether an order has been shipped or is still in the processing stage.

User Nickname
A name or alias used to identify the user in the system.

Order Amount
Total monetary value of the order including product prices and shipping fees.

Payment Method
The manner in which an order is paid, such as credit card or digital wallet.

Operation Actions
Available administrative actions such as view, ship, or close an order.

Product List
A detailed enumeration of items included in the order with quantities and prices.

Shipping Time
The timestamp when the order was dispatched to the customer.

Placement Time
The timestamp when the order was created by the user.

Shipper
The individual responsible for dispatching the order.

用户标签
用户标签用于分群和运营，包括“新用户”、“高活跃用户”等类型。

筛选条件
用户列表查询支持用户名模糊搜索、手机号/邮箱精准匹配、注册时间范围等筛选条件。

Product Module
Module managing product listings, including automatic removal or marking of invalid products in the shopping cart.

Cascading Control
Disabling a parent category does not affect the business validity of its subcategories but makes them inaccessible on the frontend.

Sorting Rule
Categories are sorted with smaller values appearing first, default range set between 100~999.

Order Module
Module responsible for order generation, lifecycle management, and payment system integration.

User ID
Unique identifier for users, required for all cart and order operations.

Payment System
System interfacing with the order module to handle payments, including integrations with WeChat and Alipay.

User Phone Number
Contact information used for order search and customer identification.

Shopping Cart Module
Module handling all shopping cart operations requiring login for persistence and real-time database writes.<SEP>Shopping Cart Module provides temporary storage and batch checkout for products.

Logical Disable State
A state where products are bound but logically disabled, requiring unbinding before deletion.

Login Restriction
Requires users to be logged in to perform shopping cart operations and persist data.

Order Lifecycle
Describes stages from order creation to payment, shipping, delivery, and optional evaluation.

Order ID
Unique identifier for each order, generated upon submission.

Order Confirmation Page
Page displaying order details for user verification before payment.

Alipay
Payment platform integrated with the order module for processing transactions.

商品管理员
商品管理员负责查看和管理商品列表，包括基本信息如价格、库存、分类、状态等。

WeChat
Payment platform integrated with the order module for processing transactions.

Performance Optimization
Recommends caching product prices and cover images while using delayed stock verification during checkout.

商品列表
商品列表展示所有商品的基本信息，支持筛选和关键字搜索。<SEP>List of ordered items.

商品ID
商品ID是商品的唯一标识符，如100001。

Product Price
Cost of individual products, part of the total order calculation.

Shipping Fee
Additional charge applied to the order total, if configured.

Delivery Address
Specifies the location for order delivery, chosen or added by the user.

商品标题
商品标题是购物车列表中展示的商品主名称。<SEP>商品标题是商品的前台展示名称，如小米智能手环8。

State Persistence
All modifications in shopping cart require real-time writes to the database.

Payment Success Page
Page shown after successful payment completion.

所属分类
所属分类是商品的类别，如智能穿戴。

单价
单价是购物车列表中展示的商品最新价格。<SEP>单价是商品的价格，如￥199.00。<SEP>Price per item.

上下架状态
上下架状态表示商品是否在前台展示，如已上架/已下架。

库存
库存表示商品的可用数量，如500。

编辑商品
编辑商品功能允许修改已有商品的内容，如标题、描述、图片等。

操作
操作包括编辑、上下架、删除商品等管理功能。

删除商品
删除商品功能为逻辑删除，不影响历史订单，仅后台管理员可操作。

商品上下架
商品上下架功能控制商品在前台商城的展示状态。

新增商品
新增商品功能允许后台用户创建新商品并上架至商城。

CDN
Content Delivery Network used for storing and accelerating access to review images.<SEP>CDN是图片上传建议使用的统一存储服务，限制最大2MB。

物理删除
物理删除会将商品数据从数据库中彻底移除。

逻辑删除
A deletion method where records are marked as deleted rather than physically removed to maintain data continuity.<SEP>逻辑删除是一种数据删除方式，避免影响历史订单数据。<SEP>逻辑删除maintains data in the database while hiding it from public view.

富文本编辑器
富文本编辑器如QuilJs用于编辑商品详情内容。

分类管理模块
分类管理模块为商品提供层级分类结构，支持后台对类目进行维护。

商品详情
商品详情包含商品的详细描述信息，支持HTML或富文本格式。

主图
主图是商品列表/详情页显示的图片。

User
User refers to individuals interacting with the system, performing actions like managing addresses, browsing products, and adding to favorites.<SEP>A user who interacts with the system, places orders, and provides reviews.<SEP>A user who can submit reviews for products they have purchased.

Order
An order placed by a user, containing items to be purchased.<SEP>A purchase record associated with a user, allowing one review per product per order.

Review
Feedback provided by a user for a purchased item, including ratings, text, and images.<SEP>User feedback on a product, including a star rating, text, and optional images.

Product
Product refers to items available in the marketplace, displayed with details like price, stock, and reviews.<SEP>An item available for purchase, with details such as title, price, and reviews.<SEP>An item that can be reviewed by users, listed in the product management system.

Shopping Cart
Shopping cart allows users to temporarily store products before checkout.<SEP>A temporary storage for items a user intends to purchase.

Shipping Information
Details about the recipient such as name, phone number, and address for order delivery.

Product Review Score
An aggregated score based on user reviews, used to calculate product popularity.

Review Image
An image uploaded by a user as part of their review, up to 5 per review.<SEP>Images uploaded by users to accompany their reviews, limited to five per review.

Payment Time
The specific time when the payment for an order is completed.

Comment Submission
The process of submitting a review, including entering text, selecting a rating, and optionally uploading images.

Logistics Information
Information regarding the shipment and delivery status of an order.

Comment Filtering
System for sorting and filtering reviews based on criteria like rating and image presence.<SEP>A process to filter reviews based on criteria such as '好评' (positive), '差评' (negative), or '有图' (with images).

F1.6
F1.6 refers to the verification code functionality used for account binding, identity verification, and password recovery.

F2.2
F2.2 refers to the product list browsing functionality, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

F2.4
F2.4 refers to the product favorite/unfavorite functionality for logged-in users.

F2.3
F2.3 refers to the product detail page functionality, displaying complete product information.

F1.5
F1.5 refers to the delivery address management functionality allowing users to add, edit, delete, and set default addresses.

F2.1
F2.1 refers to the homepage product display functionality, showcasing attractive products and categories.

SMS/Email
SMS or email is the medium used to send verification codes to users.

Homepage
Homepage is the main entry point displaying carousel images, categories, and recommended products.

Carousel
Carousel refers to the rotating banner display on the homepage showing featured content.

Product Detail Page
Web page displaying product information along with user reviews.

Default Address
Default Address is the primary delivery address automatically used for orders.

Category
Category refers to the product classification system used for organizing products.

Admin
Staff member responsible for managing product listings and reviewing system settings.

Star Rating
A 1-5 scale rating system for user reviews, with 5 being the default highest score.

Super Admin
Administrator with full permissions to manage all aspects of the product system.

Comment
Comment refers to user-generated reviews displayed on product detail pages.

Anonymous User
A user who chooses to hide their identity, displaying a placeholder like "User123".

Review Audit
Process of screening reviews, with options for automatic approval or manual intervention.

自动打标签
A rule-based system for automatically assigning tags to users.

客服主管
A role with permissions to reset user passwords and oversee customer service operations.

Product Management
Backend system allowing administrators to create, edit and organize product listings.

用户状态管理
Manages user statuses such as active, banned, or deleted (which is irreversible).

安全机制
Security measures including logging all sensitive operations and recommending dual approvals.

操作日志
Records of sensitive operations performed by administrators, such as password resets.

导出权限限制
Restrictions on exporting user data, requiring approval to prevent leaks and allowing partial field exports.

评价管理
A backend module for managing user reviews, ensuring content health and safety.

行为指标建议
Suggested metrics for user behavior, including login frequency, spending, order count, and review activity.

Comment Statistics
Aggregated metrics like average rating and positive review rate, displayed on product pages.

黑名单监控
A system feature to monitor users with high complaint rates or frequent refunds.

标签管理
A feature supporting batch assignment and removal of tags for users, used in data export, reporting, and operational scenarios.

客服
A role responsible for handling user reports and customer service tasks.

审核/驳回评论
A function for reviewing and approving or rejecting user comments to maintain platform standards.

删除评论
A function to permanently hide comments, making them visible only in the backend.

站内信
An internal messaging system used to notify users after password reset.

评论状态管理
A function to manage the status of comments, such as marking them as active or pending.

查看评价列表
A function allowing administrators to view all user reviews with filtering options.

内容审核专员
A role dedicated to reviewing and moderating content on the platform.

用户举报处理
A function for addressing reports from users about specific comments.

评价内容关键词
Keywords used for filtering and searching comment content.

短信
SMS notifications sent to users after password reset.

审批流程
An approval process required for exporting user data to prevent leaks.

双人复核
A security mechanism requiring dual approvals for sensitive operations.

商品收藏状态
商品收藏状态可实时反映在列表/详情页中，收藏记录存在数据库中，可用于“我的收藏”列表。

data.entity_name: 同一用户收藏同一商品仅记录一次
data.content:
同一用户收藏同一商品仅记录一次
同一用户收藏同一商品仅记录一次支持取消收藏操作。

购物车模块
为用户提供商品暂存与批量结算前的过渡操作，支持加购、修改数量、删除、选中等能力，是订单系统的重要前置流程。

data.entity_name: 用户可最多收藏500个商品
data.content:
用户可最多收藏500个商品
用户可最多收藏500个商品(上限可后台配置)。

未登录用户
未登录用户不支持购物车功能，前端可使用本地缓存模拟(不入后端)。

已登录用户
已登录用户可以使用完整购物车功能(加购、修改、删除、提交结算)。

F3.1加入购物车
用户在浏览商品时，若未准备立即购买，可先将商品加入购物车暂存，方便批量结算。

F3.3删除购物车商品
用户可删除购物车中已失效或不再需要购买的商品，支持单个或批量删除操作。

商品ID非法
提示登录商品ID非法：忽略操作并提示。

商品已下架
商品不存在或已下架提示“该商品不可购买”。<SEP>商品已下架自动设为不可选中并提醒用户。

用户未登录
用户未登录提示跳转登录页。

data.entity_name: 商品数量上限为库存值
data.content:
商品数量上限为库存值
商品数量上限为库存值，下限为1。

购物车上限为100条记录
每个用户购物车上限为100条记录，默认选中状态为true。

数量超过库存
数量超过库存提示“超过最大库存”。

数量为负数
数量为负数拒绝并提示“数量不能小于1”。

购物车列表
购物车列表展示所有属于该用户的购物车商品记录，包含名称、封面、价格、数量、选中状态等信息。

数量选择器
数量选择器是购物车列表中的控件，允许用户通过+ / -控件实时修改商品数量。

选中状态
选中状态指示商品是否参与结算，用户可通过勾选框修改。

删除操作按钮
删除操作按钮支持用户删除购物车中的单条商品记录。

标签管理扩展性
The tag system's extensibility, supporting independent table creation and automated tag updates.

用户ID
A unique identifier for users.

昵称
Nickname of the user.

收货人
Recipient of the order.

商品封面
商品封面是购物车列表中展示的商品图片，支持点击跳转详情页。<SEP>Product cover images displayed in reviews.

电话
Phone number of the recipient.

数量
Quantity of each ordered item.

小计
Subtotal for each item.

发货时间
Time when the order was shipped.

发货人
Person who shipped the order.

关闭时间
Time when the order was closed.

关闭理由
Reason for order closure.

快递公司
Shipping company used.

运单号
Tracking number of the shipping.

订单状态
Current status of the order.

支付状态
Status of the payment.

管理员
Administrator managing the order.

评论时间范围
Date range filters for reviewing comments.

定时任务
Scheduled operations for periodically refreshing tags in the tagging system.

data.entity_name: F3.2修改商品数量 / 状态
data.content:
F3.2修改商品数量 / 状态
支持用户在购物车中调整每项商品的购买数量，以及是否参与结算(选中状态)。

关闭原因
Reason for closing the order.

时间戳
System-recorded timestamp of operations.

F3.4查询购物车列表
用户进入购物车页，可查看当前购物车中的所有商品项，包含名称、封面、价格、数量、选中状态等。

手机号
Phone number of the user.

下单时间
Time when the order was placed.

支付金额
Amount paid for the order.

购物车商品
购物车商品是用户在购物车中添加的商品项，可进行数量修改、选中、删除等操作。

用户状态
Status of the user (active/banned).

风险防控
Prevention of risks related to users.

行为数据分析
Analysis of user behavior data.

地址
Shipping address of the order.

用户管理
Management of user accounts.

操作记录
Log of actions taken on the order, including shipping and closure details.

商品明细
Detailed list of ordered items including quantity, price, and subtotal.

物流信息
Shipping details including carrier, tracking number, and time.

操作人
Person performing the operation.

订单编号
Unique ID of the order.

用户标签运营
Marketing operations based on user categorization tags.

财务对账
Process of matching financial records with exported order data.

导出订单列表
Functionality for exporting order data to CSV or Excel for financial reconciliation.

JSON/CSV
Format used for data export.

驳回原因
驳回原因specifies the reason for rejection, such as containing ads, abusive content, or false information.

举报类型
举报类型categorizes user reports into types like pornography, abuse, ads, or plagiarism.

举报人
举报人refers to the user ID or nickname of the person who filed the report.

评论状态
评论状态describes the current state of a comment, such as pending review, published, or deleted.

关闭流程
Procedures for closing orders, including state checks and refund requirements.

发货规则
Rules governing the shipping process, such as payment verification and immutability.

审核状态
审核状态indicates whether content is approved or rejected in the system.

推荐内容上下架控制
内容可随运营活动实时上架/下架，控制展示周期，灵活适配短促营销。<SEP>推荐内容上下架控制manages the visibility of recommended content.

首页公告栏配置
配置首页顶部或中部公告内容，用于展示节日通知、发货延迟、隐私更新等系统消息。<SEP>首页公告栏配置involves setting up the announcement bar on the homepage.

内容配置排序
内容配置排序allows arranging the order and display range of content.

驳回举报
驳回举报retains the original content status with a remark if no violation is found.

设为有效举报
设为有效举报hides the comment and sets its status to "举报处理中" when a report is deemed valid.

直接删除
直接删除refers to permanently hiding content for severe violations that merit immediate removal.

被举报内容
被举报内容contains the text or images of the reported content.

操作权限管理
操作权限管理restricts actions like review, deletion, or banning to specific roles, such as content administrators.

上下架规则
Rules governing the availability of products to users, where delisted products become invisible and unpurchasable.

审核模式可配置
审核模式可配置allows configuration of review modes like full auto-approval, manual review, or hybrid modes.

商品分类管理
Management of hierarchical product categories for backend maintenance and frontend display organization.

删除策略
Strategy suggesting logical deletion of products to avoid data continuity issues.

ERP集成
Integration with Enterprise Resource Planning systems for data exchange.

推荐商品位配置
用于配置首页推荐商品、分类推荐商品、搜索推荐区等，提升商品曝光和转化。<SEP>推荐商品位配置relates to configuring recommended product placements.

轮播图管理
轮播图管理involves managing the rotating display of images on the homepage.

编辑分类
Modification of category attributes such as name, order, and icon, with restrictions on ID changes.

启用/禁用分类
Control over the visibility of categories in the frontend, allowing temporary or permanent hiding.

日志可追踪
日志可追踪ensures all review and reporting actions are logged with details of the operator, time, and notes.

举报入口依赖前台
举报入口依赖前台requires the frontend to provide a report button and form for submitting reports.

排序值
Numeric value controlling the display order of categories.

分类树结构展示
Display of product categories in a tree structure, supporting multi-level nesting for comprehensive management.

新增分类
Process of adding new category nodes at any level for product organization.

父级ID
Identifier for the parent category, determining the hierarchy level.

删除分类
Logical deletion of categories without actual database record removal, subject to specific conditions.

分类ID
Unique identifier for product categories, with '0' representing top-level categories.

分类名称
Name field for product categories, e.g., '手机数码'.

状态
Indicator for whether a category is enabled or disabled for frontend display.

Recommended Products Section
Used to configure recommended products on the homepage, category recommendations, and search recommendation areas to increase product exposure and conversion.

分类路径缓存
Cached data representing the hierarchical path of product categories for quick retrieval.

Carousel Image Management
Carousel images are located at the top of the homepage and serve as the first visual focus for users, often used for promotions, hot-selling items, and guiding users to special pages.

轮播图
轮播图位于首页顶部，是用户进入页面后的第一视觉焦点，常用于推广活动、热卖商品、专题页引导。

逻辑禁用
A state where products or categories are hidden but retain their underlying associations.

Homepage Bulletin Board
Configures announcement content at the top or middle of the homepage, displaying system messages like holiday notices, shipping delays, and privacy updates.

递归结构
A structural condition where a category cannot be its own parent to avoid logical loops.
